text: The following Board Directors of the Association of Canadian Commercial Production will give a presentation on their organization, its impact on the local economy and COVID-19's impact on their sector: - Sarah Brooks, Executive Producer and Partner, School Editing; - Tony DiMarco, Executive Producer, Radke/Free Society; - Danielle Kappy, Owner, FRANK Content Inc.; - Josefina Nadurata, Founding Partner and Co-Owner, Holiday United Group; and - Gigi Realini, Owner, Partners Film Inc.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Received the presentation (September 22, 2021) from the Board Directors of the Association of Canadian Commercial Production, headed "Commercial Production during COVID-19: The Pandemic's Impact on a Uniquely Toronto Sector", for information.
